en_US: Would you like to take the Battle
Factory Multi Battle challenge?
You may team up with a friend for a
Multi Battle challenge using rental
Pokémon.
Both partners will be provided with two
rental Pokémon each.
Once entered, you and your partner
conduct Multi Battles until you lose.
After each win, you or your partner
may trade a single rented Pokémon.
If you manage to win seven matches in
a row, you will earn Battle Points (BP).
The Level 50 option starts with rental
Pokémon that only know weak moves.
The Open Level option lets you rent
Lv. 100 Pokémon with powerful moves
from the start.
Please note: a Battle Factory Multi
Battle challenge can’t be interrupted.
